class.name: MediaStreamPlayer
class.brief_description: One engine controller for native, browser, iframe and prepared-PCM media backends.
class.description: This opt-in controller leaves existing project players unchanged. It owns playback commands and advisory media metadata; applications retain evidence IDs, revisions, permissions, shared clocks, queue-entry identities, titles chosen by users, playlist selection and UI layout. Every event dictionary carries [code]type[/code], [code]source[/code], [code]playback_instance_id[/code] and [code]generation[/code]. Capture the instance and generation for the exact application entry. A new opening or [method stop] invalidates the previous generation. Callbacks from retired backends are suppressed. Seek completions also carry [code]seek_request_id[/code]. Capabilities describe backend differences. Prepared WAV playback has precise, exclusive, sample-indexed loops. Browser media and finite YouTube iframes have approximate seek-based loops. Live sources remain streamed; DVR and loop ranges are exposed only when a backend provides actual seekable ranges. Moving ranges can invalidate an active loop: only that loop is disabled, its requested boundaries remain available, and playback continues unless a separate playback error occurs. Web sources obey browser CORS, restricted-header, autoplay and networking policies. A CORS decode/readback failure may fall back to ordinary media embedding. Such a fallback cannot supply PCM or a Godot texture. DOM-only media is composed below the canvas so later Godot UI can cover it; it requires an axis-aligned main-viewport Control. Arbitrary transforms, SubViewports and fullscreen DOM composition are not qualified. Browser-managed internal media memory has no engine-enforced hard byte ceiling; HLS uses explicit buffering targets rather than claiming a total browser-memory limit. Browser media audio has independent volume control and does not pass through Godot audio buses/effects. Capabilities report these differences. YouTube remains an iframe backend on Web, never an extracted-URL or PCM backend. The documented iframe API does not provide an advertised DVR range. Specify [code]timeline_mode: "finite"[/code] only for a known finite playlist item, or [code]"live"[/code] for a known live source. Without known timeline information, unsupported seek/loop operations remain unavailable until that information is established. Native YouTube uses the existing engine resolver unchanged. This API is under qualification. Its presence does not authorize removal of existing browser fallbacks or extraction plugins.

method.name: open
method.description: Replaces the current opening. A prepare_pcm request returns ERR_BUSY without changing source, generation or playback while this controller has active or retiring preparation. Explicitly stop and await is_preparing() across process frames before submitting a replacement; no source is queued automatically. The PCM byte limit is per-request output, not total process memory. Options: [code]video[/code] (default false), [code]autoplay[/code] (true), [code]prepare_pcm[/code] (false; finite playlists only), [code]allow_browser_fallback[/code] (true), [code]mix_rate[/code], [code]max_pcm_bytes[/code], [code]timeout_msec[/code], native [code]http_headers[/code], native [code]dvr[/code] (true), browser [code]format: "hls"[/code] for non-extension manifest URLs, browser [code]timeline_mode[/code], and browser [code]youtube_show_controls[/code] (true). Set [code]youtube_show_controls: false[/code] when the application supplies playback controls; this hides YouTube controls and disables iframe keyboard shortcuts and its fullscreen button. It does not hide YouTube title/channel overlays. Volume-zero mute and restoration of the selected volume remain unchanged. Wait for [signal media_ready] before applying the shared playback position. Native transport and PCM preparation require HTTPS. Ordinary Web playback retains HTTP/HTTPS URLs under the browser mixed-content and redirect policies, including browser-supported ports and media fragments; it does not rewrite HTTP into HTTPS or claim native destination validation. Browser HTML media cannot accept arbitrary custom request headers. Invalid setup returns an error; later failures use [signal playback_error].

method.name: stop
method.description: Cancels preparation, closes playback, removes DOM resources and invalidates the opening generation. Cancellation is nonblocking: [method is_preparing] remains true until canceled decoding has retired. Keep this controller alive while awaiting that retirement before starting its next PCM request.

method.name: is_preparing
method.description: Returns whether this controller owns active or canceled-but-uncollected PCM preparation. Poll using scene-tree process frames, including while the controller is paused. This does not wait for a worker. It does not report other controllers, ordinary streamed playback, or deferred audio-server references.

method.name: get_preparation_state
method.description: Returns playback_instance_id, current generation, busy, active_count, retiring_count, active (a dictionary, empty when idle) and retiring (an array). Each active/retiring request records decoder_instance_id, request_id, its originating generation and source. Retiring identities retain the canceled opening's generation/source after stop or replacement. Keep one controller alive across playlist requests to enforce admission; replacing the controller creates a separate admission scope.

method.name: play
method.description: Requests playback or resumes an open source. Browser gesture restrictions can still apply.

method.name: set_paused
method.description: Pauses or resumes without replacing the opening.

method.name: seek
method.description: Seeks within a currently advertised range. Returns ERR_BUSY while a seek is pending, ERR_UNCONFIGURED before readiness, ERR_UNAVAILABLE without backend support, or ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER for an out-of-range/non-finite position. Wait for [signal seek_completed] before issuing another seek.

method.name: set_loop_range
method.description: Sets an exclusive-end loop in fractional seconds, inside one advertised range. PCM uses roundi(seconds * actual decoded mix_rate). Invalid requests preserve the previous loop. Seek-based loops can have gaps and must not be described as sample-accurate.

method.name: clear_loop
method.description: Disables looping while leaving playback open.

method.name: get_snapshot
method.description: Returns identity, generation, source, readiness, buffering, preparation (as returned by get_preparation_state), requested pause state, position, duration, seek status/ID, volume, metadata, capabilities, seekable_ranges and loop (active, begin, end). Unknown/live duration is not a permanent finite track length.

method.name: get_capabilities
method.description: Returns current precise_loop, seek_loop, seek, live_playback, dvr, pcm_decode and backend-specific limitations. Capability changes are also signalled.

method.name: get_seekable_ranges
method.description: Returns current start/end ranges in media seconds, optionally with timeline_origin_utc when the backend provides a UTC mapping. Ranges may move, shrink, disappear or be disjoint.

method.name: get_generation
method.description: Returns the current opening generation. Pair it with this controller's instance ID and the application's queue/evidence identity.

method.name: set_volume_linear
method.description: Sets independent player gain from zero to one, preserved across openings and fallbacks.

signal.name: playback_event
signal.description: Unified stream of the events below. Reject notifications whose playback_instance_id/generation do not match the active application entry.

signal.name: media_ready
signal.description: The opened backend is ready; payload includes a snapshot.

signal.name: playback_error
signal.description: Includes error and message. Separate from loop invalidation or a recoverable PCM-preparation fallback.

signal.name: metadata_changed
signal.description: Includes advisory metadata for this opening. Never overwrite an application's authoritative playlist/evidence title automatically.

signal.name: loop_invalidated
signal.description: Includes reason, requested begin/end and active=false. Only the loop has been disabled; no automatic boundary clamping or playback stop occurs.

signal.name: loop_changed
signal.description: Includes active, begin and end after an explicit loop command.

signal.name: finished
signal.description: The current source finished outside an active loop.

signal.name: preparation_failed
signal.description: PCM preparation failed and a browser playback fallback is being attempted. Does not by itself mean playback is unavailable.
